Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Well, here is a question. If the minion with Bauble burns or is sendt to topor. Do you have to burn Bauble?

Bauble
Type: Action
Requires: Vicissitude
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action.
[vic] Put this card on the acting vampire. Search your library and put a non-unique, non-location equipment card on another minion you control. Do not pay the cost to equip. The vampire with this card cannot attempt actions, block or vote. You may burn this card and the chosen equipment card during your untap phase or when the minion with the chosen equipment leaves the controlled region.[VIC] As above, but you may burn this card and the chosen equipment at any time.

It clearly states may, but that may only be for the first condition...

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
If the minion with Bauble burns, Bauble burns:
Rulebook 1.1.2 wrote:
>
> When a card is burned or removed from the game, any counters or other cards on it are burned.
>
Unless the minion with Bauble also has the weapon (transfered via Nod, Heidelberg, ..), you can't burn the Bauble when the minion with Bauble is banished / ... Otherwise, you could.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
@ Juggernaut1981: I didn't get that. Conditions to be matched for burning Bauble via its text are any of:
- it is your untap phase
- the minion with the equipment leaves the controlled are
- it is anyone's untap phase (sup' Bauble only)

"Conditions" isn't a VTES word, but we can agree that, once "conditions" are fulfilled, "consequences" happen. Here, "consequences" is:
- you get to choose if you want to burn the Bauble and the equipment.

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Ahh. I wrote something wrong, if you go to topor and/or burnt. Do you have to burn bba
>
I'm not sure who "you" is here.
Since we've covered the case where the minion with Bauble leaves the ready region, I'll assume "you" refers to the minion with the equipment retrieved via Bauble.
("goes to torpor" isn't an example of "leaves the controlled area" - I'll use "burn" below, but other examples would be "becomes contested", "is removed from play", "moved to the uncontrolled area", "moved to crypt / library" and probably a couple of others that don't come to mind right now)

So, suppose minion A plays Bauble, and retrieves equipment E and puts it on minion B.

Minion A now has a Bauble on them, minion B has E.

"Minion A burns" has been covered abouve.

"Minion B burns / leaves the controlled region" : Minion A has the possibility to burn the Bauble [*and* the equipment] per Bauble's cardtext. It's up to A.

"E burns" : then A can't burn the Bauble anymore and is stuck with it  [RTR 080808] (this was a reversal of a ruling from 1997)

"Bauble burns" : Depending on if it's from Bauble's text, E burns (Bauble burns from its text) or doesn't burn.  [LSJ 20090113]

I hope it's all covered here.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Option 2 is compulsory indeed, but it only applies when the minion is burned / removed from the game (rather than "when leaving the controlled region).

Option 3 - have something else burn it. (Callirus, Cleansing Ritual are those that come to mind)

In the end, if something says the Bauble burns, then the Bauble burns.

Bauble doesn't have the cascading burn effect that exists in Dual Form.

> XZealot wrote:
> If the card Bauble burns, does the equipment, the card Bauble put into play, burn as well?
>
Hm, can you check I replaced the commas properly?
If it is, the answer is no.
The old trick is to play Bauble with Callirus (see  [LSJ 20090113] for instance).

The thing is: the only way the equipment Bauble fetched burns is to choose to have it burn via Bauble's cardtext - or to have it burned otherway. if Bauble burns in any other way than via its cardtext (Scourge of the Enochians, Amaranth, ...), this won't burn the equipment.
